recognize_zh: 高倍下細胞間是淡紫紅色、帶細纖維狀條紋的膠狀基質，勾勒出數個大型空洞輪廓（萎縮脂肪細胞），其間只有零星淋巴球、中性球與紅血球，是骨髓膠狀轉化的細部表現。
features: Pale violet, finely fibrillar extracellular ground substance with streaming strands
Large rounded pale spaces outlined by matrix, consistent with atrophic fat cells
Sparse isolated nucleated cells: small lymphocyte-like cells and an occasional segmented neutrophil
Red cells embedded in the matrix, some appearing elongated or distorted
A small granular purple cluster within the matrix, likely degenerated cell or platelet debris
describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow aspirate shows a loose, pale violet, finely fibrillar extracellular matrix outlining large rounded clear spaces consistent with atrophic adipocytes. Nucleated hematopoietic cells are very sparse and include isolated small lymphocytes and an occasional neutrophil, with scattered red cells trapped in the matrix. No abnormal or blastic population is identified. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation (serous fat atrophy) of the marrow, as seen in anorexia nervosa.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is more homogeneous and waxy, often perivascular, and Congo red positive, unlike this loose fibrillar Alcian blue-positive matrix.
Myelofibrosis produces a dry tap with fibroblast-like cells and reticulin/collagen on biopsy rather than a mucoid matrix around atrophic fat cells.
Necrotic marrow contains shadowy necrotic cells and granular debris rather than intact scattered cells in an acellular matrix.
